snippet.title: 【Steam】"Campus Notes - forget me not."PV
snippet.description:
"Campus Notes - forget me not." is a Visual Novel game on Steam.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/435360/
(日本語による説明は上記サイトをご覧ください)

■Campus Notes - forget me not.
Campus Notes - forget me not. is set in the University of Tsukuba, a National university that is the focus of Tsukuba Science City.
After bumping into a mysterious girl, Yuta Kiriha finds himself trapped in a situation where the people around him routinely forget him each day.
The story centers around his attempts to solve this case with a group of friends who are in the same boat.

---App Details---
Title:Campus Notes - for get me not.
Genre:Sci-fi Visual Novel
Platform:Windows(PC)/Steam
Price:11.99 USD
Languages:English/Japanese
URL：http://store.steampowered.com/app/435360/
